ruleTitle: Protect Homepage Headline & Primary Cluster Anchor
constraintDescription: Never overwrite the Homepage (/) <title> or <h1> for secondary or Page 2 queries. Keep actuationScope as ADDITIVE_CONTENT_AND_LINKS unless explicitly recalibrating the primary anchor 'settlement agreement calculator'.
Preserve transactional tool intent on /calculator/. Never replace the <title> with informational 'How to...' phrasing.

ruleTitle: ITEPA 2003 s.403 & s.402D PENP Statutory Precision
constraintDescription: Never use promissory phrasing like 'You can expect up to £30,000 tax-free'. Always state that genuine non-contractual compensation up to £30,000 can be paid tax-free under s.403 ITEPA 2003, whereas contractual PILON and Post-Employment Notice Pay (s.402D) remain subject to income tax and National Insurance.
